abstract: The appropriate management of gynecological malignancies in association with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection is not established. To date the reported literature on the subject consists mainly of case reports. Due to the increasing prevalence of HIV infection, especially in sub-Saharan countries, the chances of finding both conditions in the same patient has produced management and ethical dilemmas. This retrospective study describes the management of 12 HIV-infected patients and compares their outcome with 29 non HIV-infected patients. The mean age of the non HIV-infected patients was 30 years (range 16-56 years), while the mean age of the HIV-infected patients was 32 years (range 20-47 years). In terms of risk factors, there were 72% of non HIV-infected women in the high-risk category compared to 50% of HIV-infected women (P = 0.468). All patients who received treatment had CD4 counts greater than 200 cells/microl. Two HIV-infected women who did not receive any form of chemotherapy due to low CD4 counts (41 cells/microl and 84 cells/microl) demised of their disease. The majority of women (86% non HIV-infected & 90% HIV-infected) received lfewer than 10 cycles of chemotherapy to attain cure. Most side effects were minor. None of the HIV-infected patients who received chemotherapy demised of their disease. In total, irrespective of risk category, there were 38 patients (93%) who were cured of their disease by chemotherapy including 10 HIV-positive patients. All patients were alive and free of disease at their last follow-up visit. Although the numbers are small, it is proposed that HIV-infected patients with choriocarcinoma and a reasonable degree of CD4 counts (>200cells/microl) should receive standard therapy.
abstract_ja: ヒト免疫不全ウイルス（HIV）感染を伴う婦人科悪性腫瘍の適切な管理はまだ確立されていない。これまでの報告は主に症例報告に限られる。HIV感染の有病率の上昇、特にサハラ以南のアフリカ諸国での増加に伴い、両疾患を併発する患者に遭遇する機会が増え、管理上および倫理上のジレンマが生じている。本後方視的研究では、HIV感染患者12例の管理を記述し、非HIV感染患者29例の転帰と比較する。非HIV感染患者の平均年齢は30歳（範囲16〜56歳）、HIV感染患者の平均年齢は32歳（範囲20〜47歳）であった。危険因子については、高リスク群の割合が非HIV感染女性で72%、HIV感染女性で50%であった（P=0.468）。治療を受けた全患者のCD4値は200cells/μl超であった。CD4値が低い（41cells/μlおよび84cells/μl）ため化学療法を受けなかったHIV感染女性2例は、病勢により死亡した。大多数の女性（非HIV感染86%、HIV感染90%）は、治癒に至るまで10サイクル未満の化学療法を受けた。副作用のほとんどは軽度であった。化学療法を受けたHIV感染患者は、いずれも病勢により死亡しなかった。危険度に関係なく、全体で38例（93%）が化学療法により治癒し、そのうちHIV陽性患者10例を含んでいた。最終受診時にはすべての患者が生存し、無病であった。症例数は少ないものの、CD4値が200cells/μlを超える妊娠性絨毛癌のHIV感染患者には、標準治療を受けるべきであると提案する。
